papers.title_en: ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models
papers.authors: Mianjie Yu, Zhongmin Zhao, Zizhao Mo, Jianxiong Liao, Wenxuan Li, Yulin Qiao, Huanle Xu, Wenquan Yang, Yongqiang Yang, Zeren Li, Ruifeng Tang, Chengzhong Xu
papers.evidence: 面向大模型异构流水线并行训练
papers.tldr: 现有异构大模型流水线训练通常通过给不同阶段分配不等层数来均衡计算时间，但粒度粗、难满足显存约束，且配置搜索代价高。论文提出异构流水线并行方案HPP，并实现ETH系统，以数据级细粒度负载均衡替代单一层划分。ETH采用分层优化、块级梯度聚合及专用搜索优化，同时处理跨流水线和阶段内失衡及非对称通信。实验显示其训练最高加速2倍、配置生成开销最高降低56倍，为异构硬件上的高效大模型训练提供了实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity.   In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. To mitigate asymmetric communication costs, ETH implements block-wise gradient aggregation. Furthermore, it integrates specialized optimizations that dramatically reduce HPP configuration search overhead. Evaluations demonstrate ETH achieves up to 2x training speedup while reducing configuration generation overhead by up to 56x compared to state-of-the-art systems. The code is available at https://github.com/YuMJie/ETH.

papers.title_en: Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training
papers.authors: Tao Huang, Chen Zhu, Antonio Alonso, Daming Li, Adarsh Goura, Jaideep Ray, Yitong Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向同步分布式训练的免协调负载均衡
papers.tldr: 同步数据并行通常向每个rank分配等量样本，但变长样本的成本差异会让最慢批次决定步时并造成设备空闲。本文提出批成本前瞻BCL：各rank本地缓冲有限窗口后，按估计成本重组固定样本数的数据包，无需跨rank协调或修改训练运行时。模拟中批成本波动最多降82.8%；8张H200上相对汇聚式MFFD快1.050—1.167倍，内部序列任务快1.197—1.343倍。工作证明可在数据加载边界消除大量失衡，并给出以p99截断控制内存风险的适用边界。
papers.abstract_en: Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be removed at the data-loader boundary, while clarifying when data preparation or broader coordination is still necessary.

papers.title_en: Lightweight Scheduling Policies for Continuously Batched LLM Serving Across GPU Architectures
papers.authors: Ashman Mehra, Akshan Agarwal, Aryeh Carmi
papers.evidence: 面向连续批处理LLM服务的GPU调度
papers.tldr: 大模型自回归解码中的连续批处理会在请求到达与完成时不断重组批次，调度策略因而直接影响吞吐、首词延迟与尾部时延。论文构建基于Python/PyTorch及真实Hugging Face执行的测试平台，比较八种轻量级策略。跨三类GPU、六个模型和1152组实验，带老化的最短提示词优先在L40S及混合负载上表现最稳健。研究表明仅知道剩余生成长度并不足以保证最优，批处理机制与硬件特性同样关键，并公开了数据集。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model serving is increasingly limited not only by model size and GPU speed, but also by scheduling during autoregressive decoding, where continuous batching interleaves requests at token granularity as sequences arrive and finish. We study whether lightweight scheduling policies can improve latency-throughput tradeoffs without changing model architectures, kernels, or deploying learned schedulers. We implement a Python/PyTorch continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution and evaluate eight policies across 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs using ShareGPT-derived traffic, six Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral models, and Modal L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs. Scheduler choice changes throughput, TTFT, completion latency, and tail behavior under fixed model, GPU, workload, batch size, and prefill budget. Aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline in many L40S and mixed-workload settings, while oracle remaining-length scheduling shows that job-size knowledge alone is insufficient because batching and hardware effects also shape performance. The custom dataset has been uploaded to Hugging Face.

papers.title_en: BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation
papers.authors: Yaoyang Liu, Shuwei Shen, Jincheng Tang, Jinguang Liu, Jinbao Xue, Hailong Yang, Ke Zhang, Yinjun Wu
papers.evidence: 通过键值缓存压缩优化大模型推理基础设施
papers.tldr: 长上下文推理中，KV缓存随序列增长成为显存与解码吞吐瓶颈，传统低秩方法往往拟合原始键或softmax前分数，未直接对齐注意力行为。BELT以注意力分布为键侧优化目标，构造可闭式求解的二次低秩代理，并学习全局Top-k秩分配。其在激进压缩下提升质量，低秩压缩最高70%，结合量化最高17.8倍缓存缩减，并带来最高3.3倍端到端解码加速。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference makes the key-value (KV) cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. We propose BELT, a low-rank KV cache compression framework. Its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits, yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. A learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. Experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. Evaluated across three LLMs and multiple benchmarks, BELT achieves up to 70% low-rank KV cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on LongBench, and up to 17.8x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization. With Triton-based GPU kernels and a quantized cache, BELT delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.

papers.title_en: Optimal Hydra: Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning for LLMs using Data-Informed Hydra-Nets
papers.authors: Gwen Legate, Rahaf Aljundi, Eugene Belilovsky
papers.evidence: 面向资源受限客户端的异构联邦大模型训练
papers.tldr: 大语言模型联邦微调受客户端算力、存储差异制约，统一的服务器—客户端模型架构难以适用。论文提出Optimal Hydra异构联邦学习框架，在全局层选择基础上，依据各客户端本地数据分布挑选注意力头，构建个性化Hydra-nets子网络。三项数据集实验显示，该方法优于基线，同时降低本地训练资源需求。工作将模型异构联邦学习推进到面向大语言模型微调的场景，并显式结合数据特征进行子网络设计。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) trained on vast amounts of data have demonstrated impressive performance over a range of tasks, but future performance gains will require increasing amounts of data and compute. Federated Learning (FL) facilitates training on decentralized private data, but client resource limitations can make training impractical, particularly as model sizes continue to expand. These resource constraints make the assumption of a shared server-client architecture impractical. Model heterogeneous FL offers a promising alternative by adapting model size to client capabilities; however, previous work is limited to the pre-training setting, and conclusions on sub-network selection do not necessarily hold for fine-tuning. Furthermore, prior approaches create client sub-networks without considering their unique data distributions, thereby overlooking the opportunity to tailor sub-network architecture to local data. Motivated by evidence that attention heads exhibit task dependency within layer defined feature spaces, we propose Optimal Hydra, a transformer based heterogeneous FL framework for fine-tuning that combines global layer selection with client specific attention head selection, aligned with local data distributions. Optimal Hydra makes explicit use of client data to produce client-specific sub-networks we call Hydra-nets. To our knowledge, this is the first model heterogeneous FL approach tailored to LLM fine-tuning. Experiments on three datasets show significant improvements over baseline methods while also reducing local resource demands.

papers.title_en: Resource-aware Sub-network Allocation for Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning
papers.authors: Zhuojun Tian, Ming Xiao, Mikael Skoglund
papers.evidence: 面向异构去中心化训练的资源感知部署优化
papers.tldr: 同步去中心化学习受节点算力、通信与内存差异制约，统一模型宽度往往被最弱设备拖慢。RASA-DL将各节点可部署的最大子网络宽度作为优化变量，结合离线硬件画像、学习效用画像及链路资源信息进行分配。该方法以满足内存和总体学习效用为约束，最小化训练轮次瓶颈时延，并通过二分搜索高效求解。在中重度异构条件下，它在相同建模轮时延下分别较最大可行统一部署提升2.80和2.43个百分点准确率，且在强非独立同分布数据下优势更明显。
papers.abstract_en: System heterogeneity in computation, communication, and memory can substantially limit synchronous decentralized learning, where each training round is constrained by resource-limited nodes. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly determining node-specific model capacities from deployment resources. We propose RASA-DL, a resource-aware sub-network allocation framework that treats the maximum sub-network width assigned to each node as a deployment variable. RASA-DL combines offline hardware profiling of computation and memory costs with deployment-aware profiling of learning utility under heterogeneous decentralized training. Using these profiles together with node- and link-level resource information, we formulate deployment as a bottleneck-latency minimization problem subject to per-node memory constraints and a required aggregate learning utility. Exploiting the monotone feasibility of the latency threshold, RASA-DL efficiently identifies the deployment through a binary-search-based allocation procedure. Experiments under controlled resource heterogeneity demonstrate favorable accuracy--latency tradeoffs. Under the Moderate and Severe regimes, the minimum-latency operating point improves accuracy over the largest globally feasible uniform deployment by 2.80 and 2.43 percentage points, respectively, at the same modeled round latency. The advantage is further amplified under strong Non-IID data heterogeneity.

papers.title_en: Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing
papers.authors: Mingjin Zhang, Jiannong Cao, Tao Wu, Xiangchun Chen, Ne Wang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型推理与键值缓存迁移的分布式边缘基础设施
papers.tldr: 地理分布式边缘协同推理把模型分片与KV缓存置于多台异构节点，但节点断连、过载时缓存迁移受限于带宽和算力，直接传输或全量重算均效率不佳。EdgeFlow将KV直接传输与基于激活值的重算结合，并让通信与计算并行执行。其进一步建模多节点迁移优化问题，利用改进线性规划松弛和二分图设计2-近似算法。真实分布式LLM平台实验显示，迁移时间最高降低45%，从而提升边缘推理连续性、鲁棒性与资源效率。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities but rely heavily on centralized cloud GPU clusters, leading to high bandwidth costs, latency, and privacy issues. Edge computing offers a solution by deploying LLMs closer to users on edge servers, yet single edge servers often cannot meet LLMs' heavy computational demands. Collaborative Edge Computing (CEC) addresses this challenge by integrating resources of multiple geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers, which jointly host small model shards and associated Key-Value (KV) cache for distributed inference. However, edge servers may disconnect or easily become overloaded, making it essential to migrate stateful KV cache to other servers for ensuring continuous service. Existing cloud-based KV cache management methods, such as direct cross-GPUs transmission and recomputation from input tokens are ill-suited for bandwidth-constrained and resource-limited edge environments. In this work, we propose EdgeFlow, a novel hybrid KV cache migration scheme that integrates direct KV cache transmission with activation-based recomputation, leveraging parallel computation and communication to minimize migration time. On this basis, we formulate a multi-node KV migration optimization problem and design a 2-approximation algorithm based on improved linear programming relaxation and bipartite graph techniques. Extensive experiments on a real-world distributed LLM inference platform demonstrate that EdgeFlow reduces migration time by up to 45%, significantly enhancing the robustness and efficiency of distributed LLM inference in collaborative edge computing.

papers.title_en: RAPID-DNN: Reliability-Aware Partitioning for Robust DNN Inference Deployment on Edge AI
papers.authors: Mukta Debnath, Krishnendu Guha, Debasri Saha, Amlan Chakrabarti, Susmita Sur-Kolay
papers.evidence: 面向异构边缘加速器的可靠性DNN划分
papers.tldr: 异构边缘加速器在低电压、老化与热应力下易出现运行时比特故障，传统仅优化时延和能耗的划分策略会导致推理精度明显受损。RAPID-DNN通过权重与激活故障注入刻画逐层脆弱性，并以该敏感度驱动三目标NSGA-II联合优化时延、能耗和预期精度退化。在混合随机故障下，平均Top-1精度提升9.81个百分点、预期退化降低36.86%，仅增加2.38%时延和3.34%能耗。该工作将可靠性纳入部署划分目标，为受限边缘AI提供更稳健的推理方案。
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on heterogeneous edge accelerators are increasingly exposed to runtime hardware faults. Tight power and resource budgets push these platforms toward aggressive voltage scaling and limit the use of hardware fault mitigation, while process variation, thermal stress, and device aging raise fault rates further. The resulting transient bit level corruptions propagate through inference and can sharply reduce prediction accuracy. Existing DNN partitioning frameworks optimize latency and energy under fault free assumptions, so their deployment strategies often fail to sustain reliable inference in realistic operating conditions. This paper presents RAPID DNN, a reliability aware partitioning framework that adds runtime reliability as a third optimization objective alongside latency and energy. RAPID DNN first characterizes layer wise reliability through systematic fault injection in the weight and activation domains to identify vulnerability critical layers. The resulting sensitivity profile guides a three objective NSGA II optimizer that jointly minimizes inference latency, energy consumption, and expected fault induced accuracy degradation. We evaluate RAPID DNN on AlexNet, SqueezeNet, ResNet18, VGG16, and MobileNetV2 using heterogeneous Eyeriss and SIMBA accelerator profiles. Across fault models and injection probabilities, it consistently improves inference robustness over the fault agnostic baseline. Under the representative mixed random fault configuration, RAPID DNN raises average Top 1 accuracy by 9.81 percentage points and reduces average expected fault induced accuracy degradation by 36.86%, at a cost of 2.38% average latency overhead and 3.34% average energy overhead. These results show that treating reliability as a partitioning objective enables robust DNN deployment on heterogeneous edge accelerators under runtime hardware faults.

papers.authors: Yousef Irshaid, Dara Varam, Mohamed I. AlHajri
papers.evidence: 面向异构分布式客户端的联邦优化算法
papers.tldr: 联邦学习在非独立同分布客户端上追求平均精度时，易牺牲部分客户端并造成性能不公平。FedPCD将常规联邦聚合作为优先目标，把客户端性能要求写成约束，仅施加满足约束所需的最小修正。多种异质基准显示，它在全部配置中取得最高全局精度，并在几乎所有设置中领跑最差10%客户端精度。该方法兼顾精度、波动和更快收敛，为不改变主优化方向的公平联邦训练提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. Across heterogeneous FL benchmarks, FedPCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the highest global accuracy across all configurations and leading worst-10% client accuracy in nearly all. FedPCD further preserves competitive trade-offs between global accuracy and client performance variability. Beyond this trade-off, FedPCD demonstrates faster empirical convergence, reaching matching or superior performance in substantially fewer communication rounds.

papers.title_en: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
papers.authors: Rodrigo Moreira, Larissa Ferreira Rodrigues Moreira, Joberto S. B. Martins, Tereza C. Carvalho, Flávio de Oliveira Silva
papers.evidence: 面向5G边缘推理的AI基础设施
papers.tldr: 现有5G系统虽能传输张量，却无法感知其对应的推理阶段、服务意图与运行语境，导致边缘协同推理多为应用绑定方案。论文提出按需推理IoD，将切分推理封装为类CAMARA网络API，并在5G用户面带内传递切分感知的张量上下文。基于可编程UPF测试床和视觉AI任务的评估表明，自适应切分可作为网络服务运行，并避免静态配置的固定成本。该工作使计算、上下文与连接能力可由电信网络协同编排，推动网络原生AI服务落地。
papers.abstract_en: Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations. Including our findings, split inference becomes more than offloading when the service intent, runtime partitioning, and tensor transport are made visible to the mobile data plane. This opens a path toward network-native AI services, in which programmable telco infrastructure coordinates computation, context, and connectivity for user-facing applications.

papers.title_en: Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby, Fabrizio Pittorino, Manuel Roveri
papers.evidence: 面向高效深度学习基础设施的纯整数训练
papers.tldr: 低精度训练虽能显著节省资源，但现有可扩展方法通常仍在权重更新或优化器状态中依赖浮点。本文将权重、梯度和激活统一表示为带二次幂指数的INT8尾数，并以纯整数完成前反向、更新及优化。借助五类可组合算子和分组速度机制，模型在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100与ImageNet上获得有竞争力精度。该工作首次展示现代CNN和ViT可在全INT8整数算术下训练，并将训练张量内存降至FP32约四分之一。
papers.abstract_en: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). This allows complete implementation of trainable integer layers, including convolutions, batch and layer normalization, softmax, and GELU. A per-group velocity mechanism with independent exponent tracking preserves gradient precision across neurons and channels with diverse magnitudes. As every tensor fits in INT8, training memory is roughly 4x smaller than the FP32 baseline. We validate our training algorithm on CNNs (ResNet-18/34/50/101, MobileNetV2) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Ti / B), demonstrating for the first time that training neural networks with INT8 tensors and integer arithmetic can achieve competitive accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet at a reduced memory budget.

papers.title_en: Space AI Infrastructure: Where the Edge Meets the Orbital Cloud
papers.authors: Zhanwei Wang, Jianhao Huang, Min Sheng, Kaibin Huang
papers.evidence: 轨道边缘与云端AI基础设施的系统路线图
papers.tldr: 论文面向在轨人工智能从单星载荷走向全球级服务的需求，追问卫星星座如何提供可与地面数据中心竞争的人工智能能力。作者提出空间人工智能基础设施的三阶段演进路线：星载AI、空间边缘AI与空间云AI。架构上，以低轨自由飞行星座承担近用户计算、接入和回传，以晨昏太阳同步轨道的编队星座构成空间数据中心。案例表明，该方案可为全球数百万并发用户提供数据中心规模的基础模型推理，并为端到端词元服务的系统设计给出原则。
papers.abstract_en: The fusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and space technologies is extending spaceborne intelligence beyond onboard payloads toward a global infrastructure, here termed Space AI infrastructure (SpaceAI-Infra). Its promise rests on two distinctive advantages of space systems: abundant solar energy in orbit and the global reach of satellite constellations. Realizing this promise hinges on a fundamental systems question: How should satellite constellations be designed and orchestrated to deliver data-center-scale AI services competitive with their terrestrial counterparts? This article develops a roadmap-oriented answer. We first chart the evolution of SpaceAI-Infra through three progressive stages: onboard AI, Space Edge AI, and Space Cloud AI. By revisiting the space-constrained fundamentals for end-to-end token services, we derive enabling design principles and translate them into an integrated space edge--cloud architecture. The communication-centric space edge comprises free-flying LEO constellations that provide user-proximate computing and form the access and backhaul fabric for cloud AI services. Complementing the edge, the computing-centric space cloud comprises formation-flying satellite constellations organized as space data centers in dawn--dusk sun-synchronous orbits. A case study demonstrates that the proposed architecture can support data-center-scale foundation-model inference for millions of concurrent users worldwide.

papers.title_en: Federated Coreset Subsampling for Distributed Memory Banks
papers.authors: Jason Witzemann, Daniel Pröll, Sebastian Hegenbart
papers.evidence: 面向联邦分布式训练的鲁棒核心集聚合
papers.tldr: 多工厂生产场景中，各站点数据分布相关但不完全一致，集中共享异常检测记忆库面临数据孤岛、域偏移与设备传感器差异。论文将基于记忆库的PatchCore适配为联邦框架，提出双重子采样与联邦子采样两种核心集构建策略。前者融合已有核心集，后者在分布式数据上直接生成新核心集。方法提升冷启动检测表现，并对域/传感器偏移及不可靠客户端参与更具鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, industrial processes can span multiple factories and goods are often produced at multiple sites, leading to a shared yet non-identical distribution of data across locations. To address this, we propose two federated approaches for i) combining existing coresets (Double Subsampling) and ii) creating new coresets (Federated Subsampling) in a distributed anomaly detection setting. In particular, we adapt the memory bank based PatchCore algorithm to a federated setting, resulting in increased cold-start performance, resilience to domain- and sensor-shift, and resilience to unreliable actor participation, a common problem in classical, network based federated learning strategies.

papers.title_en: LocalTrain: Integer-Only Local Learning for Energy-Efficient CNN Training on Edge FPGAs
papers.authors: Shiqi Ding, Xuanyu Liang, Xinyang Liu, Boyang Li, Zhiqiang Que, Guosheng Hu, Jiayang Li
papers.evidence: 面向CNN训练的低能耗FPGA基础设施
papers.tldr: 边缘端CNN训练受跨层依赖、梯度缓存和量化尺度管理制约，传统方案难兼顾能效与精度。LocalTrain采用局部学习，在FPGA上以共享整数矩阵引擎同时训练主网络和区域辅助分类器，并片上完成误差扩展、分块梯度折叠及历史尺度转换。KV260在CIFAR-10和SVHN分别达到76.57%与91.85%准确率，平均功耗约4.20瓦。相较Jetson Orin Nano同类整数方法，其训练能耗降低40.4%和42.1%，证明整数局部学习适合低能耗边缘训练。
papers.abstract_en: Local learning reduces cross-layer training dependencies, but an efficient accelerator must still retain operands, accumulate gradients, and select quantization scales. We present an FPGA system that trains a CNN and its regional auxiliary classifiers using a shared integer matrix engine. Compact errors are expanded on chip, gradients are folded tile by tile, and historical scales permit direct output conversion. At 200 MHz, the KV260 prototype achieves 76.57% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 91.85% on SVHN at approximately 4.20 W mean module power. Effective matrix throughput is 31.22 and 31.57 GMAC/s, respectively. Against the same integer method on Jetson Orin Nano, measured training energy is 40.4% and 42.1% lower, with $1.86\times$ and $1.82\times$ longer runtime; measurements use the respective platform power domains. Selected state checks and matching complete-run prediction counts support functional agreement with the software reference.

papers.title_en: VortexSynth: Profile-guided benchmark reconstruction for GPU architecture research
papers.authors: Huanzhi Pu, Chulhyung Park, Chihyo Ahn, Ramyad Hadidi, Hyesoon Kim
papers.evidence: 面向架构评估的性能剖析驱动GPU工作负载重建
papers.tldr: 面向新型GPU架构，闭源或依赖不兼容编程模型的现有工作负载难以直接迁移，手工改写与验证成本高。VortexSynth以参考工作负载为输入，先通过剖析选取热点核函数，再合成目标语言实现并校验输出等价性。系统利用翻译代理实现比较性能剖面差异，并将剖面签名缺口反馈给智能体迭代优化。在Vortex开源指令集GPU的机器人案例中，全部活跃核函数对通过等价性检查，迭代过程能够缩小剖面距离，为架构研究自动构建可执行代表性基准。
papers.abstract_en: GPU architecture research requires representative benchmarks that can execute on new designs. However, many vendor-tailored workloads and library kernels cannot run directly on research architectures because their implementations are closed-source or rely on programming models unsupported by the target architecture. Migrating existing kernels requires manual effort to adapt their implementations and validate their behavior. This creates a need to automate workload migration to target platforms.   We present VortexSynth, a framework that uses profile-guided benchmark reconstruction to construct GPU benchmarks from reference workloads. Our workflow selects hot kernels through profiling, synthesizes implementations in the target programming language, verifies output equivalence, and measures profile differences using a translated proxy implementation. The resulting profile signature gap is supplied to an agent for iterative refinement. We evaluate the method on Vortex, an open-ISA GPGPU, using robotics as the application domain. All active kernel pairs pass both output-equivalence checks, and the case studies show that iterative refinement can reduce profile distance.

papers.title_en: ProvQML: Efficient Provenance Capture for Machine Learning as Recursive Aggregate SQL [Extended Version]
papers.evidence: 具备可扩展溯源能力的分布式机器学习系统
papers.tldr: 将机器学习算法写成分布式递归聚合SQL虽可实现大规模声明式分析，但现有系统难以可扩展地记录训练过程溯源，限制了模型可解释性。ProvQML提出面向递归聚合SQL的溯源执行引擎，在计算过程中高效采集细粒度信息。系统同时记录样本对特定模型状态梯度的局部贡献，以及跨迭代参数更新序列的全局溯源。多类模型和常用数据集实验表明，该方法能有效捕获两类溯源，为SQL化机器学习的解释与审计提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: Expressing ML algorithms as recursive aggregate SQL queries over distributed systems enables large-scale declarative data analytics, yet no existing system supports scalable provenance capture, necessary for ML explainability. We present ProvQML, a provenance-aware recursive aggregate SQL engine that efficiently captures fine-grained provenance while evaluating ML algorithms as recursive aggregate queries. We capture two types of provenance: (i) local provenance that records the contribution of each training instance to gradient computation at a specific model state, and (ii) global provenance that encodes the sequence of model parameter updates across the iterations. Extensive experiments on widely used ML datasets demonstrate that our approach efficiently captures both provenance for various ML models over widely used ML datasets.

papers.title_en: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces
papers.evidence: 内存高效的仅前向大语言模型微调优化
papers.tldr: 零阶优化可在不存储反向传播梯度的条件下微调大语言模型，但在高维参数空间中扰动估计方差很大。现有随机低秩子空间虽能降维，却常与具体任务的下降方向失配。AdaSub-ZO依据有限差分反馈逐层学习投影矩阵，并用子空间动量稳定随基变化的噪声估计。实验表明，该方法优于现有零阶基线，降低估计方差并加快收敛，为内存高效且任务自适应的微调提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.
